headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Infosys opens 1.1 million sq.ft. new block at Pocharam campus in Hyderabad.
AIMIM workers block Sudarshan Reddy’s convoy in Nizamabad.
BJP has criticised Congress over Delhi Chalo terming it an attack on democracy.
Thousands of students, workers protest in Italy under heavy security.
bullets_ur: Infosys ne Hyderabad ke Pocharam campus mein 1.1 million square feet ka naya block khol diya.

BJP ne Delhi Chalo par Congress ko tanqeed ka nishana banatay huay ise jamhooriyat par hamla qarar diya hai.
